skills.description: Coordinate one cross-domain product outcome through typed domain-skill calls, exact returns, joined proof, and resume; never implement or self-certify.
Process one evidence-backed business feature through modeling, challenge, publication, reconciliation, and durable backend-owned authority.
Design and challenge one architecture with observed-state, tech-stack, data-ownership, realization, and proof boundaries.
Process one backend outcome through prerequisite binding, contract and solution design, implementation, repair, and proof in a frozen source boundary.
Process one frontend outcome for create, audit, repair, redesign, debug, or reconciliation through native UX/UI operators, code, one blind Sol visual review, quality, and UAT.
Assure one bounded delivery through measured readiness, executable rule binding, approved repairs or debt, and exact static quality proof.
Verify one product-decision flow from frozen inputs and independent Behavior, UX, and UI evidence, then publish its canonical UAT snapshot and result pair.
Manage one immutable release through deploy, monitor, recover, rollback, and public steady-state proof under exact authorization.
Operate one bounded shared observability, Sonar, or tunnel service without taking product deployment ownership.
Manage one runtime workspace identity, routed source set, task session, provenance record, or portable checkpoint without becoming product authority.
Publish one approved Git boundary or portable continuation checkpoint from exact mission-owned source heads without force semantics.
Diagnose one failed workflow from immutable evidence and return a report without repairing source or mutating external state.
